Priya (AE): Heads up 1: large banking customer wants a 10-day BYO-CMK POC. Requirements: FIPS HSM, automated rotation + emergency manual rotate, pre-POC pen test, and cross-region DR. Can we support?

Tom (SE): Yes for Private/Dedicated. Need HSM model + PKCS#11 endpoint and whether they expect us to host connector. Also need QPS and unwraps/day to size nodes.

Ravi (Crypto-Ops): Support key-wrap handshake & wrapped-key replication. For BYO-HSM we require PKCS#11 + reachable agent. Rotation modes: scheduled automation or manual via API. Performance note: unwrap adds ~5-12ms; cache wrapped DEKs to cut ops.

Priya (AE): Customer will share model + firmware by EOD. QPS ~120 concurrent, ~8k unwraps/day, latency target p50 <120ms.

Carmen (Legal): We'll draft SOW addendum: custody, firmware support boundaries, pen-test rules, and escrow opt-in.

Omar (Finance): POC fees: $2.5k setup + 50$/hr crypto ops after included hours. Dedicated pricing separate.

SecBot: Security questionnaire submitted; vendor pen-test window requested; response ETA 48h.

Tom (SE): Action list: 1) Priya collect HSM details 2) Ravi prepare short rotation runbook + sample logs 3) Carmen & Omar draft SOW/quote. Sync in 36h.
